sloka: नर्दमानाः च नादेन पात येयुः विहंगमान् ।ईदृशानाम् प्रसूतानि हरीणाम् काम रूपिणाम् ॥१-१७-२९॥
transliteration: nardamānāḥ ca nādena pāta yeyuḥ vihaṁgamān ।īdṛśānām prasūtāni harīṇām kāma rūpiṇām ॥1-17-29॥

translations.english: Those monkey commanders created heroic monkeys among the chief monkey clans who later proved the best among clanleaders.
